documentation.content: More than 20 5xx responses in a 5-minute window. Backed by the http_requests_total OTel counter (src/observability/http-observability.interceptor.ts), labeled by route template/method/statusCode (low-cardinality — no raw URLs or IDs). Starting threshold is an absolute count, not a % of traffic, since no production baseline exists yet — revisit once real traffic volume is known. VERIFY the metric.type filter below in Metrics Explorer before applying: GCP's OTLP ingestion path may use a different prefix than assumed here (see docs/monitoring/README.md).
